citation.note: Pay change notice: Provide written notice to employee of any change in compensation, hours, or pay frequency; timestamp delivery and store in employee record.
Payroll records (MCL 408.479): 3-year retention of payroll records with itemized deductions.

Earned Sick Time Act: employers with 11+ employees provide 72 hours paid sick leave annually (1 hour per 30 hours worked); employers with 10 or fewer provide 40 hours paid plus 32 hours unpaid (72 hours total). Small-employer rule effective 2025-10-01.

body.interaction_rule: Earned Sick Time Act: employers with 11+ employees provide 72 hours paid sick leave annually (1 hour per 30 hours worked); employers with 10 or fewer provide 40 hours paid plus 32 hours unpaid (72 hours total). Small-employer rule effective 2025-10-01.

Final pay timing on discharge: Trigger immediate payment calculation on termination; if amount cannot be determined by close of business, schedule payment for next regular payday with documented reason.

body.deadline_description: Final pay timing on discharge: Trigger immediate payment calculation on termination; if amount cannot be determined by close of business, schedule payment for next regular payday with documented reason.

citation.note: Minimum wage compliance: Default non-exempt classification; verify hourly rate against Michigan minimum wage ($13.73 in 2026, indexed annually after October 1, 2027). Scheduled step $14.05/hour with a 40% tipped phase.

Employee access to personnel files (MCL 423.503-504): Employees may inspect within reasonable time after written request; may obtain copies, employers may charge a reasonable fee for copying costs; no more than 2 inspections per calendar year.
Termination in retaliation for filing workers' compensation claim or unemployment claim; Whistleblowers' Protection Act (MCL 15.361 et seq.) protects reports of suspected violations.
